mapper.insert: INSERT INTO registration (visit_no, patient_id, doctor_id, visit_date, registration_fee, status, registered_at) VALUES (#{visitNo}, #{patientId}, #{doctorId}, #{visitDate}, #{registrationFee}, #{status}, #{registeredAt})
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM registration WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} AND doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND visit_date = #{visitDate} AND status IN #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE registration SET status = #{nextStatus}, consultation_started_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{expectedStatus}

mapper.delete: DELETE FROM registration WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{expectedStatus}
